Welcome

Finding out what MAKES the World Tick.

Hi, I'm Antoni Debicki. I am an eighteen year old at the College of Staten Island interested in computer science, website development, full-stack development, amateur, indie game development, and the development of neural networks.

About me Contact

About Me

I was born on November 6th, 2007 on Staten Island, so I've basically been here my entire life. I find it incredibly easy to take apart things and figure out how they work in the file, and that is especially good for my interest in computer science. I am also into postmodernist-adjacent literature by Jean Baudrillard, Gilles Deleuze, and Felix Guattari, and I read many books based off of cybernetic economics, like Stafford Beer's "Brain of the Firm" (1972), and Paul Cockshott's breakout Cybernetics book, "Towards a New Socialism" (1994).

  • I am Interested in software logic, software design, user-based interfaces and how to generally mess with a computer
  • I love ergodic fiction, especially the kind where you have to work towards a goal. I spend most of my time reading and writing
  • I am a huge fan of ballsy writers like Mark Z. Danielewski, the brain behind the House of Leaves. Baudrillard and Deleuze counting as a part of that Ballsy writers list.
  • I work best in an environment where I don't work with others, mainly on my own, because I feel I learn the best that way.

  • CSC 225/220/211 - Assembly, C, C++, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, REACT.
  • PSY 100 - Psychology class.

Interests
